UNDERDRIVE CLUTCH AND INPUT SHAFT
TSB Revision
AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE OVERHAUL
23B-53
DISASSEMBLY SERVICE POINT
<< A>> SNAP RING REMOVAL
1. Set special tools MD998907 and MD998924 as shown in the 
illustration.
2. Compress the return spring and remove the snap ring.
ASSEMBLY SERVICE POINTS
>>A<< D-RING INSTALLATION
1. Install a D-ring in the groove in the underdrive clutch retainer 
and piston, and in the groove in the outside of the spring 
retainer. Be careful not to twist or damage the D-rings.
2. Apply ATF or petroleum jelly (Vaseline) to the D-rings.
>>B<< SNAP RING INSTALLATION
1. Place the snap ring on top of the spring retainer, and then 
set special tool MD998907 as shown in the illustration.
2. Compress the return spring and install the snap ring.
